items.title: Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.33123v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. items.summary_zh: 论文关注自演化agent harness（持续更新记忆、提示词、技能与工具的过程）带来的新型安全风险。作者指出，现有研究多聚焦harness misevolution，或只验证候选harness与单个组件更新，忽略了多个组件更新叠加后产生的组合式安全失效。文章提出识别这类失效的方法，并设计运行时监控机制，在harness演化过程中动态检测异常行为组合，从而在部署前或运行中拦截风险。该工作为自演化agent系统的安全评估与防护提供了新的分析视角和可落地的监控手段。

items.title: The Psychology of an AI Hacker
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.30361v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Human hackers rely on composure, persistence, vigilance, and confidence under pressure. We investigate whether analogous emotion representations in AI models can improve cybersecurity AI performance. Using CT0, a 4B-parameter cybersecurity transformer released as alias3-micro, we extract 171 emotion directions from its residual stream without retraining and evaluate steering interventions on cybench-subtask across 415 campaigns. Steering toward calm, serene, or desperate improves performance by 1.6 to 2.1 percentage points across ten seeds, while other emotions show limited or negative effects. Results depend strongly on steering direction, layer, and intensity. We further introduce a lightweight context-aware router that selects emotion directions dynamically during execution. With approximately 80 ms decision overhead per request, this approach improves performance by 4.2 percentage points across ten seeds, outperforming fixed steering
items.reason_zh: 从模型残差流中提取情绪方向并用于网络安全任务，是AI可解释性与能力调控结合的有趣探索。
items.summary_zh: 人类黑客依赖冷静、坚持、警觉与压力下的自信。本文探究AI模型中类似的情绪表征能否提升网络安全任务表现。作者使用4B参数的网络安全Transformer CT0（发布名alias3-micro），在不重新训练的情况下从其残差流中提取171个情绪方向，并分析这些方向与模型在攻防任务中表现的关系。研究展示了通过可解释性手段定位并调控模型内部情绪表征的可行性，为理解AI能力与“心理状态”的关联提供了新视角。

items.title: Not Where You Think: Protecting Location Privacy Against Reasoning-Based Geolocation
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.30439v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent large reasoning models can infer where ordinary photos were taken using only visual information, creating a serious location privacy risk even when metadata and obvious geographic identifiers are removed. To understand the mechanism behind such fine-grained localization, we develop GeoTrace, a structured reasoning attack that exposes how models extract location-relevant visual clues and compose them through coarse-to-fine geographic reasoning. We evaluate GeoTrace on a worldwide benchmark of 525 ordinary images spanning natural, urban, residential, and human-centered scenes while excluding famous landmarks and direct location indicators. Our results show that GeoTrace localizes 25.71% of images within 1 km with Gemini-3-Flash and 16.95% with GPT-5-mini. items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，近期的大型推理模型能够仅凭视觉信息推断普通照片的拍摄地点，即使元数据和明显的地理标识已被移除，仍构成严重的位置隐私风险。为理解这种细粒度定位背后的机制，作者提出 GeoTrace——一种结构化推理攻击方法，用于暴露模型如何逐步推理出地理位置。研究在此基础上探讨相应的防护思路，旨在抵御基于推理的地理定位攻击，为图像分享场景下的位置隐私保护提供分析与对策。

items.title: Your Six AI Models Are Really Two: The Math of Correlated Mistakes
items.raw_text:
Ask several models the same question, take a vote, and you get fewer independent opinions than you paid for. One formula says how many, and I checked it on six open models and 1,500 exam questions.

The post Your Six AI Models Are Really Two: The Math of Correlated Mistakes appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.reason_zh: 通过数学公式和实验揭示多个AI模型的错误高度相关，投票集成效果有限，具有反直觉洞察。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了多个AI模型在回答同一问题时错误的相关性，指出尽管使用了多个模型，但它们的独立意见数量远少于预期。作者提出了一个公式来计算有效独立模型数，并在六个开源模型和1500个考试问题上进行了验证。结果表明，模型间的错误高度相关，导致集成投票的收益有限，这对模型集成策略提出了重要警示。
items.title_zh: 你的六个AI模型其实只有两个：相关错误的数学

items.title: How Vercel Agent accesses production safely
items.raw_text:
An agent working on production systems needs permission to act. A request like “fix this deployment” doesn’t tell you upfront which actions it will take or what access it will need. Grant agents broad access and a mistake can affect unrelated resources. Ask for approval at every step and the user has to approve individual actions before they know how the agent intends to solve the problem. Repeated prompts can turn that review into a habit of clicking approve.

Vercel Agent starts by investigating the problem, then proposes a plan showing what it would do and what access it would need. Approving that plan grants the additional permissions to carry it out, so the user can review the proposed fix before authorizing any changes.

items.title: From Tokens to Credits to Outcomes: Pricing AI Across Models, Applications, and Cloud Platforms
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.30701v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Between 2023 and 2026, AI changed how software is priced. Traditional SaaS charged per seat because serving one more user cost almost nothing. Model inference has non-zero marginal cost, and usage varies by orders of magnitude across customers, producing prepaid credits, metered usage, hybrid seat-plus-usage models, and outcome pricing that supplement, and in rare cases replace, seat-based pricing. These pricing models have not been systematically characterized. This paper presents a reproducible study of public pricing artifacts - pricing pages and documentation - across three cohorts: the full Forbes AI 50 (2026) as the AI-native core sample, cloud platforms selling AI services included by a documented rule, and a frozen purposive cohort of 9 distinctive designs. items.reason_zh: 系统梳理 2023–2026 年 AI 定价从按席位到按 token、积分、结果的演变，对从业者定价决策有参考。
items.summary_zh: 2023 至 2026 年间，AI 改变了软件的定价方式。传统 SaaS 按席位收费，因为多服务一个用户几乎零成本；而模型推理有非零边际成本，且不同客户用量相差数个数量级，于是出现了预付费积分、按量计费、席位加用量混合模式，以及补充性的结果定价。论文跨模型、应用与云平台梳理这一演进，分析各类定价结构背后的成本逻辑与适用场景。
items.title_zh: 从 Token 到积分到结果：跨模型、应用与云平台的 AI 定价

items.title: The internet’s Wuhan moment
items.raw_text: AI is turning every old bug into a serious problem. The Internet that survives will be safer--but less open.
items.reason_zh: 以“互联网的武汉时刻”为喻，论述AI如何放大旧漏洞并迫使互联网在安全与开放之间重新权衡，观点深刻。
items.summary_zh: Exponential View文章以“互联网的武汉时刻”为比喻，探讨AI如何将每一个旧漏洞变成严重问题。文章认为，AI强大的代码分析和漏洞挖掘能力正在加速安全威胁的暴露，迫使互联网进行一场类似疫情初期的全面审视。最终存活的互联网将更安全，但也会更封闭。文章从安全、开放性和监管角度分析了这一转变的深层影响。
